## The structure

**Substantive discussion is unified.** Biology, economics, statistics, engineering, and welfare debates happen in one place — the [Substantive discussion hub](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/3) — rather than fragmenting across Workshop / Model / PQ silos.

**Process discussion is split by activity** — three separate hubs for three distinct coordination tasks: workshop logistics, PQ framing, and platform/UX.

GitHub Discussions is a flat stack of threads per category; the structure below is maintained by hand.

## Quick decision tree

| I want to... | Use... |
|---|---|
| Comment on a specific line, paragraph, parameter, or equation | [**Hypothesis**](https://hypothes.is/) — click the `<` tab on the right edge of any dashboard page |
| Debate actual cost values, biology, engineering, welfare, or methodology | [**Substantive hub (#3)**](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/3) |
| Discuss how to *frame* a Pivotal Question (resolution, jurisdiction fork, retiring/splitting) | [**PQ framing hub (#4)**](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/4) |
| Discuss workshop logistics, scheduling, session format | [**Workshop hub (#2)**](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/2) |
| Suggest UX, visual, page-layout, or commenting-tool improvements | [**Platform & UX hub (#16)**](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/16) |
| Report a code bug | [**GitHub Issues**](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/issues) |

Reading GitHub Discussions is open to everyone; posting requires a free GitHub account.

## PQ framing & operationalization {#pq-framing}

**Hub:** [#4 PQ framing hub](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/4) · category: **Ideas** · [all Ideas threads](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/categories/ideas)

*How* we frame the Pivotal Questions — resolution criteria, jurisdiction forks, retiring/splitting PQs, operationalization of sub-questions CM_12–CM_20.

| PQ | Framing seed | Metaculus |
|---|---|---|
| **CM_01** — Focal cost | [#5](https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling/discussions/5) | [link](https://www.metaculus.com/c/unjournal/38815/) |
